name: TencentOpenApi_Lite_New
summary: QQ Connect (TencentOpenAPI) iOS SDK Lite 3.6.20, packaged as XCFramework for CocoaPods.
description:
Unofficial CocoaPods packaging of the official QQ Connect iOS SDK Lite (TencentOpenAPI_xcframework_Lite 3.6.20).
Includes device arm64 and simulator arm64/x86_64 slices, a framework module map for `import TencentOpenAPI`,
and the official privacy manifest.
